title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText:
3.2. Delete Section 2.3.2 and replace as follows:
2.3.2 Main runners shall be supported from the carrying channels. Direct hung suspension systems where the main runners are
supported directly to the existing structure shall not be permitted indirect hung or furring bar suspension systems designed and
installed in accordance with this code and utilizing carrying channels shall be permitted.
